text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I have finally arrived upon the doorstep of ruin, O Destiny.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: As the fated moment approaches, my right hand trembles with the influence of dark forces beyond human ken…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After completing the Arima Kinen, we return to the academy with the fourth clue.
choice_data_list: Do you know where to go?
Do you know where to go?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But of course… If the divine truly exists in this world, there is no place more fitting.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There can be no doubt in my mind, for it's the place where I myself truly belong.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Are you ready? Then let us be off…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …to the land of our demise.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …This is it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Where the freshest seafood gets put on display!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Behold, the mock marine playground, known to the masses as the aquarium!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the Arima Kinen, we received clues that said "UM," "QUA," and "RI."
choice_data_list: And for the final clue, we received "A"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You got it! All you need to do is shuffle these papers around, and you get the word "AQUARIUM"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Talk about the answer being right under my nose… To think that the entrance to Eden was here all along!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now then, where oh where is it hiding?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This way?! That way?! Or could it be over there?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff… The heck is going on?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I've combed this place top to bottom, but all I see are displays of pre-unprepared seafood!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I can't even find a whiff of Eden's front door! Somebody's got some explaining to do!
Ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What? That voice!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Bravo! You've done well to follow the Eden Protocol and successfully reach this point!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Most impressive! And you did wonderfully as well, Trainer! Your support during the whole process was exemplary!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The Don?! What is the head of Tracen Academy doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: H-hang on. Trainer, did you have any idea about this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've long suspected the unique voice we heard at the races was Director Akikawa's, and now I finally have confirmation of it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You knew all this time and you never said anything to me?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wait… Then what the heck even is Eden?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Listen well! I shall make it all clear as day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa explains the origins of this entire scheme.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She had taken note of Gold Ship's wild yet powerful passion, and hoped to focus it on the Twinkle Series by making the experience more exciting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus she created the Eden Protocol, a plan to keep Gold Ship motivated using chapters and clues from a mysterious "Book of Secrets."

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: In conclusion! The true Eden you sought was the utopia forged by Umamusume in the Twinkle Series itself!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Therefore, you have already arrived! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon! Talk about anticlimactic!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Buuut… I've got to admit you put on a good show.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The Book of Secrets and clues, I get. But how the heck did you infiltrate my dreams?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Your dreams? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: C'mon. It was you who spoke to me in my dreams, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You know, the whole, "Ship of gold, resting beneath the waves…"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Uncharted territory lies just before you… Now is the time to unleash your true potential…" Stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So how'd you do it? Was it cutting-edge technology? Or some mind-bendy telekinesis?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ngggh?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: N-nonsense! That phenomenon is beyond my knowledge!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Believe me! I have no involvement whatsoever in those dreams!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …For realsies?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dang, this is like one of those fantasy stories where a divine being awakens in someone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Or maybe it's more like those thrillers where the main character discovers they have a second hidden personality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus concludes Gold Ship's Twinkle Series, though the situation is still completely shrouded in mystery!
"Ship of gold, resting beneath the waves…"
"Welcome to these pristine lands, yet unmarred by any other…"
"However, your journey does not end here… Set your sights on the brilliant future…"
"Go forth upon the golden path, which shall lead you far, far to the distant horizon…"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship: The Ultimate Unsinkable Battleship (End)
